text_data.text:
—A person's face at mealtime is a mirror of their life. Run this business long enough, and you start to think that way.

"Boss, can I get another tanmen? ...And a beer, by the glass!"

That girl said she works in show business or something. Looks like every day's so full she can hardly stand it. You can tell from her face and the way she eats.

"A second bowl already...! You must really like tanmen, Hello."

"Ahaha... I do love it, of course, but my meals are so irregular, so it's kind of making up for that... This way I get my vitamins and fiber too!

...Oh, boss! A seasoned egg on top too, please! Hehe, that takes care of protein ♪

And you, Tazuna... you're the classic type. Shoyu ramen, no extra toppings."

"Hehe. Old-fashioned shoyu ramen just feels comforting somehow, so I can't help it.

Back in my school days, I used to go to a shop on the tree-lined avenue nearby... It wasn't fancy to look at, but its signature dish was a simple, honest shoyu ramen you never got tired of."

"Wow! So your after-school life back then was at a ramen shop...!"

"At first I went in as, you know, a little reward to myself for working hard...

Then the owner asked me, 'Something good happen?' When I told them, they laughed and gave me a large portion. Before I knew it... hehe, I was a regular."

"Aww! That kind of place is the best!"

"It was. When my hard work paid off. Before I took on something big. They'd listen and give me a push.

And after something truly—painful happened, too. The owner and the regulars I'd befriended listened so kindly.

Until the shop closed, missed by everyone, I went there so, so many times.

...Oh? Hello?"

"Sniff...! S-sorry... I'm just... weak to stories like this~~~...!!"

"A-ahaha...

...Maybe that's why. Whenever I see a shoyu ramen like the one I ate back then, I just have to order it.

Even in Hakodate or Sapporo, I had shoyu instead of salt or miso... Maybe because a taste close to that familiar shop felt like it would give me strength."

That's right—a face at mealtime is a mirror of life. Those eyes... I know them well. A bowl for reminiscing about youth gone by, huh.

...Still, this girl knows her stuff, knowing about that legendary shop...

"This soup is so rich in flavor, though... It's wonderful!"

Heh. You bet. Ramen evolves with the times, too. Mine's the classic, but it ain't just nostalgia. It's a flavor I reached through endless refinement... Wonder if a girl like you can tell—

"Chicken... scallop... kombu... Oh, there's dried shiitake in here too, isn't there? Carefully, so carefully, taking plenty of time. A broth where nothing overpowers the rest. Your passion for the prep work, boss... I'm truly impressed."

The girl's eyes turn to me as she says it. ...Heh! Now that's a surprise. This girl's... no ordinary customer. That guess was perfect...!

[Tenacious as a Raging Wave] Meisho Doto

Into the final straight, I take the lead. All that's left is to run to the finish—

"Now then, let us bring down the curtain—with my glorious victory!"

Ah... of course it's Opera O. She's already right behind me.

I know the view ahead, too. I've burned it into my eyes so many times.

Even when I make my move at the perfect moment, Opera O is always one step ahead. When she chases me, she always passes me. When I chase her, I never reach her.

Not just in races, either. I've admired her for so, so long, always reaching for her—and still, someone like me could never catch that back of hers.

This time, the next, and the one after that. Surely it'll always be the same view from now on—

(—No! I... I...!!)

Opera O first, me second. I've challenged her so many times, and it was always the same result.

Even so... I can't let myself think "maybe next time."

(Because I... I don't want to give up yet...!)

By two and a half lengths, by half a length, and sometimes—by the slightest nose. Again and again and again, I came in second, shown Opera O's greatness closer than anyone.

Even so, I kept admiring her. If anything, my wish only grew stronger.

I want to be like Opera O. I don't want to think "someone like me." I don't want to stay hopeless. I want to believe I can truly shine.

The old me couldn't even dream of it. It's because I met Opera O that I can wish for it for real.

That's why—

"That's why... I won't lose...! This time, for sure...!!"

Because I still haven't shown Opera O how serious I am. And that frustrates me so much.

It's not just that I want to win. I want to answer Opera O's brilliance with my own—

"—! This running... Could it be that the hero has taken up the sword Nothung—!"

Even just a few more centimeters. Even a little further forward, further ahead—!

"I'm... going to WIIIN!!!"
